findings.desc: .lattice/story/actives/B-1550/plan.md:25 Required plan content includes artifacts/commands, code touchpoints, tests/negative controls, rollout/acceptance, but CHK-001 verificationIntent/evidence only check trigger/default, decision-doc always-on, independence/staleness, negative controls, and registry. The docs_check evidence would still pass if the artifact/CLI surface, file-level plan, rollout, or acceptance sections were absent. severity high
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by extending docs_check evidence to cover Proposed Artifacts, Proposed CLI Surface, File-Level Execution Plan, Rollout Plan, and Acceptance Criteria in docs/requirements/decisions/three-round-two-host-review-escalation-execution-plan.md; see verificationEvidence intentRef B-1550:F-001.

findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/three-round-two-host-review-escalation-execution-plan.md:196 says review-escalation.json can be written when status is requested, but lines 381-383 and 443 define review_escalation_status as read-only. WHY: the plan must choose on-demand computation or a separate mutating writer/gate artifact path; otherwise implementation either violates command-policy scope discipline or drops the promised artifact. Severity: medium.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by changing review-escalation.json semantics: read-only review_escalation_status must not write it; persistence belongs to DONE gate evaluation or a separate mutating review_escalation_snapshot command; see verificationEvidence intentRef B-1550:F-002.

findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/three-round-two-host-review-escalation-execution-plan.md:236 lists counted host_verdict identity fields and lines 275-286 define the independence predicate, but neither requires a signature over the local verdict payload nor verification of that signature before counting; keyId/identityDigest remain self-asserted labels, so the planned gate can still be spoofed by fabricated session/key values despite the story requiring signature/material-bound independence. severity: high
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by requiring canonical local host_verdict payload signatures, signature verification before counting, keyId/signature key consistency, and signed material binding; see verificationEvidence intentRef B-1550:F-003.

findings.desc: CHK-001 verificationEvidence intentRef B-1550:F-001 still uses one alternation command: rg -n "Proposed Artifacts|Proposed CLI Surface|File-Level Execution Plan|Rollout Plan|Acceptance Criteria" docs/requirements/decisions/three-round-two-host-review-escalation-execution-plan.md. WHY: rg exits 0 if any one label matches, so the evidence would still pass if Proposed CLI Surface, File-Level Execution Plan, Rollout Plan, or Acceptance Criteria were removed individually. I confirmed the semantics with printf "## Proposed Artifacts\n" | rg -n "Proposed Artifacts|Proposed CLI Surface|File-Level Execution Plan|Rollout Plan|Acceptance Criteria" returning exit=0. F-001 is therefore not fully resolved: the document currently contains those sections, but the recorded coverage evidence does not mechanically require all artifacts/commands/code touchpoints/rollout/acceptance dimensions. severity high
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by replacing broad alternation evidence with conjunctive anchored rg -q checks for Proposed Artifacts, Proposed CLI Surface, File-Level Execution Plan, Rollout Plan, and Acceptance Criteria; see verificationEvidence intentRef B-1550:F-004.
